blocks.text: BANGKOK — A 19-year-old Filipino pop star emerged victorious in the inaugural Asian edition of Eurovision on Saturday, beating competitors in a dazzling show featuring power ballads, dance-pop performances and spectacular pyrotechnics. Carmelle was crowned the first-ever winner of the Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok for her rendition of “Sobra-Sobra” (Too Much), a song […]...
